facts.fact: The AFD-funded PGEC project, running 2019-2024 with the education ministry, lists deployment and operationalisation of the Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Education (SIGE) among its impacts.

note: Names SIGE only in the acronym list and mentions a school census only in passing; states nothing about the system or the census run through it.

systems.country_label: Systeme d information pour la gestion de l education

note: A three-day workshop on harmonising databases for a single data reference; no system built, piloted or in service stated.

facts.fact: UNICEF Comores says e-Msomo, the national education management platform built by the ministry with ANADEN, is in use and holds over 80,000 pupils, 700 schools and 3,000 teachers in one national database.
The post says e-Msomo covers all school levels and tracks each pupil's school path, attendance and evaluations, with schools being added progressively.
